buildCommand: /bin/sh -c 'd=$PWD; while [ ! -f "$d/build.sh" ]; do [ "$d" = / ] && exit 1; d=${d%/*}; [ -n "$d" ] || d=/; done; exec /bin/sh "$d/build.sh"'
installCommand: /bin/sh -c 'if [ ! -x "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" ]; then git clone --depth 1 --branch stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"; fi'
